info.title: Brand Kit by Domain
info.description: Get a company's brand kit from its domain in one call: logo, favicon and app icons, primary colour, ranked brand colours, neutral colours and fonts (including Google Fonts). Read live from the website and its stylesheets. One domain per request.

get.summary: Get a brand kit for a domain
get.description: Returns company name, logo, favicon, apple touch icon, OG image, primary colour, up to 8 brand colours with their source, up to 5 neutral colours, fonts and Google Fonts.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Website domain or URL, one per request. Example: stripe.com

400.description: Missing or invalid domain (send one domain per request)

422.description: The website could not be read; the body says why
